---
title: "END TEDDINGTON NOW!"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
start_date <- as.Date("2025-07-23")
today <- Sys.Date()
days <- as.numeric(today - start_date)
```

It has been **`r days`** days since our collective nightmare began.

Use the tool below to compare the probabilities of different combinations of comedians and footballers that Max Rushden happened to see during the Teddington Days. Let's end his reign of terror. 

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 600
from shiny import App, ui, render, reactive
import pandas as pd

# Placeholder data for comedians
comedians_data = {
    "Name": ["John Smith", "Jane Doe", "Bob Johnson", "Alice Williams", "Charlie Brown", "Diana Prince", "Frank Miller", "Grace Kelly"],
    "Probability": [0.85, 0.72, 0.91, 0.68, 0.79, 0.88, 0.75, 0.82]
}

# Placeholder data for footballers
footballers_data = {
    "Name": ["Mike Johnson", "Sarah Connor", "Tom Brady", "Emma Watson", "David Lee", "Lisa Park", "Nick Fury", "Olivia Green"],
    "Probability": [0.92, 0.78, 0.86, 0.71, 0.89, 0.83, 0.77, 0.94]
}

comedians_df = pd.DataFrame(comedians_data).sort_values("Probability", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
footballers_df = pd.DataFrame(footballers_data).sort_values("Probability", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.tags.style("""
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital,wght@0,400;1,400&display=swap');
        * {
            font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif !important;
        }
        /* Match the table container width exactly */
        .column-6-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            width: 100%;
        }
        .table-container {
            border: 2px solid #8B4513;
            padding: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background-color: rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.4);
            box-sizing: border-box;
            width: 100%;
        }
        .search-box input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border: 2px solid #8B4513;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
            font-size: 1em;
            background-color: rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.8);
        }
        .search-box input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #654321;
            background-color: rgba(255, 248, 240, 1);
        }
    """),
    ui.tags.div(
        ui.output_text("result"),
        style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 30px; padding: 15px; background-color: rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.8); border-radius: 5px; border: 2px solid #8B4513;"
    ),
    ui.row(
        ui.column(6,
            ui.tags.div(
                ui.h4("Comedians", style="text-align: center; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"),
                ui.input_text(
                    "comedian_search",
                    label=None,
                    placeholder="Search comedians...",
                    value=""
                ).add_class("search-box"),
                ui.output_ui("comedians_list"),
                class_="column-6-container"
            )
        ),
        ui.column(6,
            ui.tags.div(
                ui.h4("Footballers", style="text-align: center; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"),
                ui.input_text(
                    "footballer_search",
                    label=None,
                    placeholder="Search footballers...",
                    value=""
                ).add_class("search-box"),
                ui.output_ui("footballers_list"),
                class_="column-6-container"
            )
        )
    ),
    style="padding: 20px; background-color: #f5e5ba; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"
)

def server(input, output, session):
    selected_comedian = reactive.Value(None)
    selected_footballer = reactive.Value(None)
    
    @output
    @render.ui
    def comedians_list():
        # Filter comedians based on search
        search_term = input.comedian_search().lower() if input.comedian_search() else ""
        if search_term:
            filtered_df = comedians_df[comedians_df["Name"].str.lower().str.contains(search_term, na=False)]
        else:
            filtered_df = comedians_df
        
        header = ui.tags.thead(
            ui.tags.tr(
                ui.tags.th("Name", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; background-color: rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.2);"),
                ui.tags.th("Probability", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; background-color: rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.2);")
            )
        )
        
        rows = []
        for idx, row in filtered_df.iterrows():
            name = row["Name"]
            prob = row["Probability"]
            is_selected = selected_comedian() == name
            
            row_style = "cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; "
            if is_selected:
                row_style += "background-color: #8B4513; color: white;"
            else:
                row_style += "background-color: rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.6);"
            
            name_escaped = name.replace("'", "\\'")
            rows.append(
                ui.tags.tr(
                    ui.tags.td(name, style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"),
                    ui.tags.td(f"{prob:.2f}", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"),
                    **{"onclick": f"Shiny.setInputValue('comedian_click', '{name_escaped}', {{priority: 'event'}});"},
                    style=row_style
                )
            )
        
        table = ui.tags.table(
            header,
            ui.tags.tbody(*rows),
            style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 2px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"
        )
        
        container = ui.tags.div(
            table,
            class_="table-container",
            style="max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto;"
        )
        return container
    
    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.comedian_click)
    def _():
        if input.comedian_click() is not None:
            clicked_name = input.comedian_click()
            # Toggle: if already selected, deselect; otherwise select
            if selected_comedian() == clicked_name:
                selected_comedian.set(None)
            else:
                selected_comedian.set(clicked_name)
    
    @output
    @render.ui
    def footballers_list():
        # Filter footballers based on search
        search_term = input.footballer_search().lower() if input.footballer_search() else ""
        if search_term:
            filtered_df = footballers_df[footballers_df["Name"].str.lower().str.contains(search_term, na=False)]
        else:
            filtered_df = footballers_df
        
        header = ui.tags.thead(
            ui.tags.tr(
                ui.tags.th("Name", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; background-color: rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.2);"),
                ui.tags.th("Probability", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; background-color: rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.2);")
            )
        )
        
        rows = []
        for idx, row in filtered_df.iterrows():
            name = row["Name"]
            prob = row["Probability"]
            is_selected = selected_footballer() == name
            
            row_style = "cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; "
            if is_selected:
                row_style += "background-color: #8B4513; color: white;"
            else:
                row_style += "background-color: rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.6);"
            
            name_escaped = name.replace("'", "\\'")
            rows.append(
                ui.tags.tr(
                    ui.tags.td(name, style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"),
                    ui.tags.td(f"{prob:.2f}", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"),
                    **{"onclick": f"Shiny.setInputValue('footballer_click', '{name_escaped}', {{priority: 'event'}});"},
                    style=row_style
                )
            )
        
        table = ui.tags.table(
            header,
            ui.tags.tbody(*rows),
            style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 2px solid #8B4513; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;"
        )
        
        container = ui.tags.div(
            table,
            class_="table-container",
            style="max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto;"
        )
        return container
    
    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.footballer_click)
    def _():
        if input.footballer_click() is not None:
            clicked_name = input.footballer_click()
            # Toggle: if already selected, deselect; otherwise select
            if selected_footballer() == clicked_name:
                selected_footballer.set(None)
            else:
                selected_footballer.set(clicked_name)
    
    @output
    @render.text
    def result():
        comedian = selected_comedian()
        footballer = selected_footballer()
        
        if comedian and footballer:
            comedian_prob = comedians_df[comedians_df["Name"] == comedian]["Probability"].values[0]
            footballer_prob = footballers_df[footballers_df["Name"] == footballer]["Probability"].values[0]
            product = comedian_prob * footballer_prob
            return f"Probability of success: {comedian_prob:.2f} × {footballer_prob:.2f} = {product:.4f}"
        elif comedian:
            return f"Selected comedian: {comedian}. Select a footballer."
        elif footballer:
            return f"Selected footballer: {footballer}. Select a comedian."
        else:
            return "Select one comedian and one footballer."

app = App(app_ui, server)
```

For more details on methodology and the full code, see the [GitHub repo](https://github.com/lindsayevanslee/end-teddington-now).
